title: Frontend: Paginated Article Bookmark Viewer
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Paginated Article Bookmark Viewer. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({items=[A,B,C,D,E],pageSize=2}). Render page-size li[data-article=LABEL] rows, Bookmark[data-bookmark=LABEL] toggles, Next/Previous[data-action=next/previous] clamped at valid pages. [data-testid=page] is 1-based or zero for empty. [data-testid=saved] contains comma-joined saved IDs in insertion order. Bookmarks survive page changes.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Store page/query controls and bookmarked article IDs separately.
alternativeApproaches: Add remote pagination with stale-response protection and explicit loading/error states.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Bookmark across pages; filter shrinks total; empty page.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
